responses.value: Keeping 65% of clients instead of 90% likely means the buyer raised prices after the deal. I'd compare renewal rates before and after the deal, by client, and ask clients who left why.
Revise: clients whose broker stayed renewed at 92%. The losses follow the 12 brokers who left.
Renewal rates for clients whose broker left against those whose broker stayed. If both renewed near 92%, I'd drop it.
